text_block_list.text:
Victory in the Arima Kinen! She may not 
have achieved the Autumn Senior Triple 
Crown, but she was undeniably the leading 
lady.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe's condition is improving even 
further. The new "connection" was growing 
stronger as well.
